steps.what: Verify energy analysis results and recommendations for the audit report
Prepare audit report tables and explanations of energy savings

loop.purpose: Draft explanations from verified audit findings
loop.input: Verified results, measure assessment and cited site evidence
loop.output: Report narrative linked to source findings with numeric tables inserted unchanged
loop.check: Auditor checks every recommendation, causal claim, qualification and number against the approved analysis and actual site evidence
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported explanations or inconsistent results return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates fill tables first, but varied findings require contextual prose beyond fixed text

steps.what: Approve and issue the exact energy audit report

tasks.design: Export verified results from energy analysis software {OTHER} into a native {DOCS} report template before considering a bounded narrative draft. The auditor checks meaning and approves the exact report; the model neither calculates savings nor issues an energy label.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report tables and explanatory wording are assembled separately from verified analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reporting can reuse model outputs, with bounded drafting for varied narrative.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining uncertainty and distinguishing feasible recommendations from untested options.
tasks.human_edge: Stand behind the recommendations and explain their limits to the client.
tasks.altitude: Less report assembly with unchanged responsibility for audit conclusions.

reach.task: Translate audit findings into scoped implementation questions
reach.learn: Evidence traceability and limitations of projected savings

evidence.claim: OptiMiser calibrates home energy models against utility bills and produces customer-ready reports; this supports report capability, without measured audit-report labour savings.
The bounded narrative draft and 18-hour gross reduction are E1 model-knowledge design assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary begins after analysis and technical recommendations are completed. Their production belongs to separate calculation and feasibility tasks and is counted once; s1 only verifies and captures them for this report.

Auditor produces report-ready building ID, analysis revision, baseline period, units, energy totals, measure IDs, projected savings, cost assumptions, limitations and evidence references in s1. Its full 35 hours include field capture and reconciliation. Missing or unapproved results remain manual and are not inferred.
Report template owner is the auditor; native reporting is tested first. Existing generated reports earn no new saving. Five focal upkeep hours cover template, source-link and draft exceptions.
research_questions: Does review-inclusive drafting reduce report time without overstating savings or feasibility?

approvals.approved_version: Exact report revision, numeric results, recommendations, qualifications, evidence links and recipient; changes void issue approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+27+20=82, gross=18, upkeep=5, net=13. High assumes 40% less report assembly after semantic review; low requires full manual narrative for unusual audits plus upkeep. Analysis, site work and final issue retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify weatherization health and safety issues

steps.what: Examine planned weatherization work and actual building conditions for safety concerns
Identify health and safety issues and refer required specialist assessment

tasks.design: Retain building examination and professional identification of health and safety concerns. The plan in {DOCS} supports assessment, while absent evidence or specialist questions remain explicit rather than becoming an automatic safe-status flag.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safety depends on site conditions, interactions between measures and specialist evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest provides no validated safety-assessment replacement.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden hazards and changes to ventilation, moisture or combustion conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when inspection is insufficient and require specialist advice.
tasks.altitude: Safety assessment effort and responsibility are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Energy report and customer-chat products do not establish automatic health or safety assessment of planned weatherization; retaining inspection is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is auditor identification and referral, excluding specialist investigations and remediation. Site observations shared with the energy audit are owned once in the roll-up.
Auditor produces observed risk evidence in s1 with full time retained. Project designer supplies the existing plan; no complete hazard register or safe-to-proceed flag is assumed.
Use native plan and safety-document access first. No new automated process means no incremental upkeep; national safety requirements remain to be established.
research_questions: Which conditions require specialist inspection before any recommendation can proceed?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+40=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Examination and safety judgement retain full time; no duplicate report-writing share is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify energy baseline, candidate measures and calculation assumptions
Calculate potential energy savings for the specified scenarios
Check calculated savings, interactions and sensitivity against building evidence

tasks.design: Configure existing energy modelling software {OTHER} to run verified scenarios instead of repeating workbook operations. The auditor checks baseline fit, measure interactions and sensitivity; no model supplies engineering inputs or declares savings guaranteed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeat scenario setup and arithmetic are spread across manual workbook operations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native energy models can reuse a checked baseline and explicit measure parameters.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain occupancy, weather effects and interacting measures.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether a numerical scenario represents the actual building.

ambition.what: Compare a second technically feasible measure combination during an audit

tasks.altitude: More time can go to sensitivity interpretation, without automatic investment decisions.

evidence.claim: OptiMiser calibrates home energy models against utility bills, supporting native energy modelling capability without proving a local calculation-time saving.
Removing repeated workbook setup after source verification is an E1 design scenario, not a measured outcome.

assumptions: Boundary is scenario calculation after site evidence exists, excluding data collection visits, technical feasibility decisions and reporting. Those actions are counted once in their own tasks.

Auditor produces building/period IDs, energy quantities and units, weather basis, occupied hours, envelope and system parameters, measure IDs, efficiencies and interaction assumptions in s1. All 40 hours retain capture and source checks; unavailable fields use explicit manual estimation and sensitivity, never silent defaults.

Auditor selects a validated calculation method and version within s1. Test native scenario tools first; six focal upkeep hours cover input/schema checks and method regression checks. Existing formula runtime is not labour: high savings require manual scenario operations actually present today.
Additional scenario demand is an ambition outside the fixed-output saving estimate; no investment or energy label is issued here.
research_questions: Do repeated scenario operations disappear after capture, calibration and sensitivity review are timed?

already_counted.description: Calculation field capture and method selection
Model fit, interactions and sensitivity review

approvals.approved_version: Exact baseline dataset, method/version, measure parameters, interactions, units and result revision; changes require new validation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+25=65, gross=35, upkeep=6, net=29. High requires currently repeated manual scenario setup and native validated coverage. Low assumes bespoke cases retain all manual operations plus upkeep. Existing calculation runtime and extra scenario demand earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyse technical feasibility of energy measures

steps.what: Review proposed energy-saving measures against building and process constraints
Analyze technical feasibility and identify specialist or implementation conditions

tasks.design: Retain professional feasibility analysis using actual building, system and operating evidence in {DOCS}. Numerical energy results can inform it, but do not establish constructability, maintenance access or safe operating compatibility.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feasibility depends on interacting physical and operational constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest's modelling capability does not establish automatic technical feasibility judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete drawings, unusual systems and constraints only exposed by specialist investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Know when projected savings are technically impractical and explain the necessary conditions.
tasks.altitude: Engineering judgement and referral responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify implementation constraints before work planning

evidence.claim: Energy modelling and report products do not establish broad technical feasibility decisions; retaining engineering assessment is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is technical feasibility evaluation, excluding separate numerical savings calculation, report production and specialist design. Reused site observations are counted once.
Auditor produces constraint and feasibility assessments through s1 and s2 with all time retained. Existing designer specifications are inputs, not assumed structured compatibility flags.
Use native document and model access first. No introduced feasibility automation creates incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which feasibility constraints require specialist analysis rather than energy-model output?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+55=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Evidence review and technical feasibility judgement retain full time; report and calculation savings are assigned to their separate tasks.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Potential gains sit in report assembly and repeated scenario operations; site safety and technical feasibility remain professional responsibilities.
reach: Discuss implementation constraints and performance uncertainty with construction supervisors
role.ambitious_version: An energy auditor who can compare an additional feasible scenario while retaining safe, evidence-based recommendations.
